text: Fixed. In `src/click/core.py`, `Option.__init__` unconditionally set `self.default = False` for flags when no default was given, so a required flag that was omitted silently fell back to `False` instead of erroring. Changed to `if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:` so a required flag keeps `default=None` and `process_value` raises `MissingParameter` ("Error: Missing option '--flag'.") when it isn't given, while `--flag` still yields `True`. Verified with a local reproduction of `test_missing_required_flag` (exit code 2 + message when omitted, `True` when given); all 488 pre-existing tests still pass.

Fixed. `click.echo` crashed with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'write'` when no standard streams are attached (e.g. pythonw on Windows). Three coordinated changes: (1) `src/click/_compat.py` — `_make_cached_stream_func` now returns `None` when the source stream (`sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr`/`sys.stdin`) is `None`, instead of trying to wrap it (annotations updated to `Optional`); (2) `src/click/utils.py` — `echo` returns early when the resolved stream is `None`; (3) `src/click/_termui_impl.py` — `ProgressBar` and `pager` fall back to a `StringIO()` when there is no stdout. Verified with a local reproduction of `test_echo_no_streams` (sys.stdout/stderr set to None: echo to stdout/stderr/bytes/empty all succeed) plus progressbar/pager checks; all 488 pre-existing tests still pass.

Done — reverted. `src/click/decorators.py` is back to its original state (`git checkout -- src/click/decorators.py`); the only remaining changes are the fixes for requests #1 and #2. Full test suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Reverted — `src/click/core.py` is back to its original state (the flag default is `False` again when no default is given, even for required flags). No other change was affected; the suite is still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed. In `src/click/types.py`, `Path.convert` resolved symlinks with `rv = os.readlink(rv)` followed by `os.path.realpath(rv)`. `os.readlink` returns the raw (often relative) link target, so a relative link was then resolved against the current working directory instead of the link's own directory — e.g. `/tmp/d/link -> target` produced `/tmp/target` instead of `/tmp/d/target`, contradicting the documented contract that `resolve_path=True` makes the path "absolute and symlinks are resolved". Replaced with `rv = os.fspath(pathlib.Path(rv).resolve())`, which resolves symlink chains correctly on all platforms. Verified with local tests: relative link, link→link→target chain, absolute target, and broken link all resolve to the real target; all 488 pre-existing tests still pass.

Still investigating: the envvar/flag_value handling in `src/click/core.py` looks correct in the paths I've tested (bool flags, non-bool flags with `flag_value`, feature switches, arguments — all resolve env values as documented). I'm narrowing down the exact divergence now; I'll report as soon as I've pinned it down.

Still investigating: flag defaults from `default_map` work in the cases I've tested (bool flags, `--x/--no-x` pairs, count, non-bool flags, nested group default maps, help text). I'm narrowing down the exact divergence now; I'll report as soon as I've pinned it down.
